name: brawler-controls
note: B-PT17 (monteslu: "if he jumps and gets in the air he floats"). Player 1 is driven by an input script like a person (human 1): steps right, jumps, jump-kicks every other jump, lands, punches a three-hit combo, grabs and knees, forty times over (mostly jumps, a jump kick every fourth, a combo every sixth, a grab every ninth), with two thugs and a punk on him. game.air_max (player 1's longest time off the ground in frames, hit-stop included) stays near a jump's 46 frames and game.jumps counts the jumps. The control (legacyair 1) is v0.4.0's stagger, which had no gravity: a fighter jab-hit in mid jump hung in the air and walked on there (air_max 155 with this script; 78 now), so it fails.
